meta.title: 蹲着怎么拍出韩女氛围感！🫧✨
meta.title_en: How to Squat With Korean-Girl Vibes!
meta.topic: 拍照教学 · 蹲姿氛围感

scenes.context: 为什么别人蹲下是大美女，而你蹲下像在拉屎？一次吃透一个拍照姿势。今天学蹲拍。语域：拍照教学，幽默引入。
sentences: 为什么别人蹲下是大美女？
Why does everyone else look gorgeous when they squat?
look gorgeous（大美女）
而你蹲下，你是来拉屎的吧。
But when you squat, it looks like you're using the bathroom.
using the bathroom（拉屎，口语）
一次吃透一个拍照姿势。
Master one photo pose at a time.
master one pose（吃透一个姿势）
paraphrase: 大美女 → look gorgeous / a knockout
scenes.speak: Why does everyone else look gorgeous when they squat? But when you squat, it looks like you're using the bathroom. Master one photo pose at a time.

scenes.context: 最关键的一点：后面一定要有一个靠背。很多瘦瘦的韩女能自己保持平衡，但像我们这种有肉肉又可爱的女生，必须要有一个这样的辅助，不然想保持平衡就只能很僵硬。语域：拍照教学，要点讲解。
sentences: 最关键的一点，我们后面一定要有一个靠背。
The key point: you must have something behind you to lean on.
something to lean on（靠背）
瘦瘦的韩女能自己保持平衡。
Slender Korean girls can balance on their own.
balance on their own（自己保持平衡）
有肉肉又可爱的女生，需要这样的辅助。
Curvy, cute girls need this kind of support.
curvy（有肉肉）
paraphrase: 靠背 → something to lean on / a backrest
scenes.speak: The key point: you must have something behind you to lean on. Slender Korean girls can balance on their own. Curvy, cute girls need this kind of support.

scenes.context: 不要正着蹲，正着蹲很显丑。要45度倾斜一点点，然后后面有个靠山往后靠。腿和脚都并拢，乖乖感对比明显。语域：拍照教学，要点讲解。
sentences: 你不要正着蹲，正着蹲真的很显丑。
Don't squat facing forward — it looks really bad.
facing forward（正着）
要45度倾斜一点点。
Angle your body about 45 degrees.
angle your body（倾斜）
腿和脚都并拢，乖乖感对比明显。
Keep legs and feet together for that well-behaved look.
well-behaved look（乖乖感）
paraphrase: 45度倾斜 → angle at 45 degrees / tilt sideways
scenes.speak: Don't squat facing forward — it looks really bad. Angle your body about 45 degrees. Keep legs and feet together for that well-behaved look.

scenes.context: 穿小裙裙挡大腿肉肉；没穿裙就背个包，放镜头这一侧。利用服饰和道具遮挡，画面更精致。语域：拍照教学，收尾要点。
sentences: 穿小裙裙，挡大腿的肉肉。
Wear a little skirt to cover the thigh fullness.
cover the fullness（挡肉）
没穿裙就背个包，放镜头这一侧。
No skirt? Carry a bag on the camera side.
on the camera side（镜头这一侧）
用服饰和道具挡一挡，画面更精致。
Block with clothes and props — the frame looks more polished.
more polished（更精致）
paraphrase: 挡大腿肉 → cover the thighs / hide the leg fullness
镜头这一侧 → the camera side / the lens side
scenes.speak: Wear a little skirt to cover the thigh fullness. No skirt? Carry a bag on the camera side. Block with clothes and props — the frame looks more polished.

practice: Why does everyone else look gorgeous when they squat?
You must have something behind you to lean on.
Angle your body 45 degrees and keep your legs and feet together.
Wear a skirt or carry a bag on the camera side.
pitfalls: Squat like going to the toilet.
It looks like you're using the bathroom.
「拉屎」是夸张口语，英文用 using the bathroom 委婉表达。
You must have something behind you to lean on.
Don't squat facing forward — it looks really bad.
Wear skirt to hide the fat meat.
Wear a little skirt to cover the thigh fullness.
「大腿肉」用 thigh fullness，不说 fat meat。
shifts: 用 lean on something（靠背）、angle 45 degrees（45度侧蹲）、well-behaved（乖乖感）
用 looks really bad（很显丑）、polished（精致）、demure（乖乖）
用 cover the fullness（挡肉）、camera side（镜头侧）、props（道具）
footer_notes: ASR 已校正：啪→pose、输助→辅助、非常香→非常僵、正着蹲、45度倾斜、靠山、并拢、小裙裙、挡大腿肉、镜头这一侧等。
